steps.dialogue: Hi! I'm **Shibuya Kanon**. I'll show you how to play the **Love Live! Official Card Game** — Loveca for short. Let's learn it together while we play a match!
First, the types of cards. Loveca uses three: **Live** cards, **Member** cards, and **Energy** cards.
Just as the name says, a **Live** card is a card for live shows. You perform live shows with these — and the first player to make **three** of them a success wins the game!
steps.dialogue_portrait: Just as the name says, a **Live** card is a card for live shows. You perform live shows with these — and the first player to make **three** of them a success wins. On phone, your win tally is the **score box** in the top HUD.

steps.dialogue: A **Member** card is your strongest tool for making a live show a success, and an **Energy** card is what you spend to bring a Member out onto the **Stage**.
This is your **Stage** — Left, Center and Right. Members you bring out stand here, and the **Hearts** they carry decide whether your live show succeeds.
Beside the Stage is your **Live card storage**. It holds up to **3** cards face down during the Live Phase — you can see your own, but your opponent's stay hidden.
Around the edge sit your **main deck storage**, your **energy deck**, the **Waiting Room** where used cards rest, and the **Success live card storage** that counts your wins.
steps.dialogue_portrait: On the **right drawer** you'll find your **main deck** and **Waiting Room**. Your **energy** count and **win tally** sit in the **top HUD** — tap energy anytime to peek at the cards.

steps.dialogue: Now that you know the cards, we can begin! Both players shuffle their **main deck** and place it in the main deck storage.
steps.dialogue_portrait: Now that you know the cards, we can begin! Both players shuffle their **main deck** — on phone, your deck lives in the **right drawer**.

steps.dialogue: A **coin flip** decides who chooses first. When you win, tap **I'll go first**.
You draw **6** cards. Set any of them aside, and you'll draw new ones. Let's **Replace 1 card**.
That's the hand exchange done. Each player then places **3** energy cards from the energy deck face up on the **energy deck storage**. You're all set — let's play!
steps.dialogue_portrait: That's the hand exchange done. Each player places **3** energy cards face up — on phone, that count shows in the **energy box** in the top HUD. You're all set — let's play!

steps.dialogue: The turn opens with the **Active Phase**: every energy card lying sideways stands upright again. From the second turn on there will be more of them waiting to stand.
Then the **Energy Phase** — one more energy card moves from the energy deck onto the energy deck storage.
steps.dialogue_portrait: Then the **Energy Phase** — one more energy card is added. Watch the **energy box** in the top HUD tick up.

steps.dialogue: Then the **Draw Phase** — draw one card from the main deck and add it to your hand.
steps.dialogue_portrait: Then the **Draw Phase** — draw one card from your **main deck** (right drawer) and add it to your hand.

steps.dialogue: Now the **Main Phase**. There are two things you can do: bring Members out onto the Stage, and use the effects of Members already there. Both, in any order, as many times as you like!

The number in a Member's **upper right corner** is her cost. Turn that many energy cards sideways and she steps onto the Stage. **Shiki Wakana** costs **2** — tap her in your hand, then tap the **Center** slot, or drag her there.
The energy you spent rests **sideways** until your next Active Phase. And look at Shiki on Stage — the **Hearts** in her upper left corner are what will carry your live show.

Here's a piece of advice: there's another way to bring a Member out — the **baton pass**. Send a Member already on Stage to the **Waiting Room**, and her cost counts as paid for a new Member of the same cost.
steps.dialogue_portrait: Here's a piece of advice: there's another way to bring a Member out — the **baton pass**. Send a Member already on Stage to the **Waiting Room** (right drawer), and her cost counts as paid for a new Member of the same cost.

steps.dialogue: After the Main Phase comes the **End Phase**. Press **End Main Phase** — then your opponent takes a turn in exactly the same order.
Now the **Live Phase**, starting with the **Live Card Set Phase**. Choose **0 to 3** cards from your hand, place them face down in Live card storage, then draw that many cards from your main deck.
Select **WE WILL!!** from your hand, then press **Set Live Cards** to put it face down. You draw one card for each card you set!
The **Performance Phase** begins — Live cards flip face up, and anything that isn't a Live goes to the **Waiting Room**. The live show is starting!
Check the **required hearts** on the Live card. **WE WILL!!** asks for one red heart, one purple heart and one grey heart — three required hearts in total.
Members on Stage give **basic hearts** (upright icons). Compare them with the required hearts: enough and the live show succeeds, short and it fails.

Short of hearts? The round penlight icon is a **Blade**. You flip one card from your main deck for every Blade on Stage — that flip is a **Yell**, and sideways **blade hearts** join your total. Shiki's Blade 2 will pull two Members whose **red blade hearts** fill the red and any hearts **WE WILL!!** still needs.
Watch the Yell flip in — then your opponent runs the same Performance. The Live Win/Loss Check comes right after.

After both Performances comes the **Live Win/Loss Check**. If only one player succeeded, that player moves one card into their **Success live card storage**. If both succeeded, the **score** in the Live card's upper right corner decides — only the higher score scores a card. Three cards there wins the game!
If the scores are exactly tied, both players place a card — except that a player who would end the game on that tie doesn't get to place one.
One last point: the turn order can change mid-game. If only one player placed a card in the Live Win/Loss Check, that player takes the first turn next round — so check before you play.
That's the basic flow of Loveca: **Main → Live → Performance**. When you're ready, try **Practice vs CPU** — skills and baton pass come up naturally as you play. Thanks for learning with me!
